chinese_title: 爱尔兰：野性之岛 第一季
aka: Ireland's Wild Islands with Eoin Warner
description:
Board a stunning 140-year-old traditional sailboat and glide around Ireland’s Atlantic islands with host Eoin Warner. Spot throngs of basking sharks, frolicking humpback whales, warring grey seals, and many more of the country’s untamed wonders.
S1 E1 - Sea of Serpents
S1 E2 - Edge of the Abyss
S1 E3 - Echoes of the Past
Production companies: Blue Ant Media, Crossing The Line Films
